os/aiueos/native/desktop.kotoba.reason: JUN-414 diagnostic v2 draft slot binds a one-byte fixed bigram result to the saved Goal; independent Mac native/QMP readback verifies cold display restore and corrupt-slot refusal. No authority, approval, real agent turn or release admission is stored. Evidence: docs/evidence/aiueos-itonami-diagnostic-result-20261027.json. W2: word 2039 bit 0 is the consent flag and bits 1 and up count Allow decisions this boot, shown on the home line. W3a: word 90 of the context reports CPUID RDRAND/RDSEED/leaf-7 availability (no entropy is drawn). W3a: when CPUID reports RDRAND the desktop executes kernel-rdrand twice and stores the low 32 bits in context words 91 and 92 (0 on failure); diagnostic only, no key. W3f: F8 opens a device-key consent request; Allow draws a seed with kernel-rdrand, derives the Ed25519 key, signs a proof message and publishes a fingerprint in word 2039 (RAM only).
